acceptance_checks: A fictional VIP official of the European Commission (no real person named) raises a warning finger and carries an EU AI ACT binder/codex.
Exactly four humans and one mechanical robot; developers distinct from the official.
An open mineral-water bottle with its cap tethered to the neck stands on the desk.
The robot hides a red REJECTED stamp behind its back, visible to the viewer.
The applicant is separate, holds the APPLICATION folder and asks for an explanation.
Expressive editorial artwork, readable joke, no speech bubbles, full composition.
seed_note: 10 seeds drawn with Python secrets.randbelow(2**31-1)+1 (owner asked for wider seed spread); identical for every model and GPU.
prompt: Humorous, richly illustrated editorial cartoon in a messy software startup office. Exactly four humans and one robot. On the left, a VIP official of the European Commission: a woman in her sixties with short swept-back blonde hair, pearl earrings and a royal-blue blazer, holding a blue binder labelled EU AI ACT under one arm and raising a warning finger at the team. At the central desk, two embarrassed developers look guilty: a woman with dark curly hair, round glasses and a navy hoodie, and a bearded man in a burgundy sweater. On the desk stands an open bottle of mineral water with its cap still attached to the neck by a small plastic tether. Beside the desk, a small teal-and-silver mechanical robot looks sheepish and hides a large red REJECTED rubber stamp behind its back, still visible to the viewer. On the right, a separate job applicant in a tan jacket holds a green APPLICATION folder and raises an open palm, waiting for an explanation. All five faces visible. Hand-drawn magazine illustration, expressive faces and gestures, layered painted colour, soft warm shadows, laptops, sticky notes, a plant and a window over city rooftops. Fictional political satire. No speech bubbles or captions.
negative_prompt: flowchart, diagram, stick figures, corporate icons, simplistic geometric people, photorealistic photograph, extra people, speech bubbles, watermarks
